spec: Per COMBAT_AND_CLASS_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md §6.1 — 3 paths × ~27 nodes; 51 points total; tier-N gates at (N-1)*5 points; tier-7 capstone gates at ~31 points; multi-rank passives ~70%; identity/keystone ~30%.
designNotes: Class-First Principle (LOCKED §4.2): class trees are weapon-agnostic. Juggernaut path's 'while no offhand equipped' clauses are offhand-conditional (allowed per §6.3) — captures the 2H tank fantasy without weapon-name gating. Wind-up tag references skill paradigm tag (not weapon name) — applies across any weapon morphed to that paradigm.

Idle-game context: no movement/standing mechanics. Frenzied state is HP-threshold based (signature §3.2 Rage Threshold), not movement. Bloodied is target debuff. AoE Cleave is encounter-radius, not tile-based.
Multi-rank flavor directive: 16 of 81 nodes (~20%) are pure stat-sticks; the remaining 65 carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor. At target.
Buff migrations: 0 (Brs pool not yet authored — no audited active buffs to migrate per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT scope). Mana flavor is PURE RAGE: passive 0, build-by-fighting only.
Cross-weapon node: Cross-Weapon Cleave (Juggernaut T6) — Marked for Cleave triggers regardless of weapon equipped (per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation).

All 3 capstones reshape Rage Threshold signature: King of Ruin (Warlord) raises threshold to 65% HP + doubles execute-range damage; Undying Wrath (Reaver) makes Frenzied window self-extending + un-killable while Rage active; Mountain (Juggernaut) makes 2H stance the structural-defense king (offhand-conditional).
Base-mechanic dependencies tracked per-node in `dependencies` array.
